question: Where can I get a list of solar PV projects currently in permitting in Germany, with location, capacity (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: Germany has no complete national register of solar PV projects in permitting. Bundesnetzagentur's Marktstammdatenregister (MaStR) publishes 63,257 solar units in status 'In Planung' (1,094 ground-mounted), with kWp/kW capacity and WGS84 coordinates above 30 kW, but pre-commissioning registration is voluntary for solar PV under § 5(4) MaStRV and merges planning, permitting and construction into one status. Bundesnetzagentur's EEG tender XLSX files add awarded kW, bidder, parcel location and award date for subsidised projects. Binding zoning stages (Aufstellungsbeschluss, Auslegung, Satzungsbeschluss) sit as PDFs across 16 Länder Bauleitplanung portals and ~11,000 municipalities.
main_caveats: Under § 5(4) MaStRV, pre-commissioning MaStR registration ('In Planung') is mandatory only for federal-law permits (e.g. BImSchG, WHG); standard solar PV is registered voluntarily until 1 month after commissioning.

MaStR has only one pre-commissioning status ('In Planung', code 31), lumping early concepts together with projects that already hold a Satzungsbeschluss, Baugenehmigung or are actively under construction ('Im Bau').
Large solar parks are often split across multiple MaStR units (e.g. PVA Schafhöfen Anlagenteil 1 at 17.6 MWp and Anlagenteil 2 at 200 MWp vs 268 MWp grid reservation in the municipal Bebauungsplan).
MaStR redacts coordinates, street and Flurstück for solar units <=30 kW (58,539 of 63,257 planned units) and masks natural-person operators under § 15(1) MaStRV.

BNetzA EEG tender lists cover only awarded subsidised bids (excluding subsidy-free PPA parks and pre-tender projects), omit coordinates, and split multi-Gemarkung bids across rows in Zuschläge_Detailliert.
Privileged ground-mounted PV within 200 m of motorways or double-track railways (§ 35(1) Nr. 8b BauGB) and rooftop PV skip Bebauungspläne; county Baugenehmigungen are not publicly listed.
answer.confidence_reason: Statutory inclusion/privacy rules (§§ 5, 15 MaStRV; §§ 35, 37 EEG; § 10a BauGB), live MaStR API/bulk exports, BNetzA tender XLSX files, all 16 Länder Bauleitplanung portals, UVP-Verbund, GEM and OSM were directly tested.

attributes.note: MaStR gives WGS84 coordinates and parcels for voluntary 'In Planung' units >30 kW (municipality/PLZ <=30 kW); BNetzA XLSX gives Gemarkung/Flurstück for EEG tender winners.
attributes.gap_note: Pre-commissioning MaStR registration is voluntary for solar PV (§ 5(4) MaStRV) and withholds coordinates/parcels at <=30 kW (§ 15(1) MaStRV). Privileged § 35(1) Nr. 8b BauGB building permits are not published; ~11,000 municipal Bauleitplanung portals behind the 16 tested Länder portals were only sampled.

attributes.note: MaStR publishes DC Bruttoleistung (kWp), AC Nettonennleistung (kW) and inverter kW; BNetzA XLSX publishes awarded Gebotsmenge (kW) per winning EEG bid.
attributes.gap_note: Projects not yet voluntarily entered in MaStR or awarded an EEG tender have no national structured MW record. Municipal Bebauungspläne legally fix Sondergebiet area (ha) and height, stating MWp/grid reservation only variably in PDF Begründungen across ~11,000 municipalities (sampled).

attributes.note: BNetzA EEG award lists publish Name des Bieters; vorhabenbezogene Bebauungspläne (§ 12 BauGB) name the Vorhabenträger; MaStR publishes Anlagenbetreiber (non-natural persons).
attributes.gap_note: MaStR's Anlagenbetreiber field does not distinguish whether the registrant is the Projektierer (developer) or future operator, and masks natural persons (243 of 1,094 planned ground-mounted units). Non-project-specific Angebotsbebauungspläne often omit developers, and municipal portals were only sampled.

attributes.note: Länder/municipal Bauleitplanung PDFs distinguish Aufstellungsbeschluss, Auslegung and Satzungsbeschluss; BNetzA certifies EEG Zuschlag; MaStR only shows generic 'In Planung'.
attributes.gap_note: MaStR merges early planning, zoning, permitted and under-construction ('Im Bau') solar units into a single 'In Planung' status (1,014 of 1,094 ground-mounted units have no permit record). State/county Baugenehmigungen and construction start are not published online, and ~11,000 municipal portals were only sampled.

attributes.note: BNetzA XLSX gives legal award notice date (Bekanntgabe des Zuschlags); municipal B-Plan PDFs give council decision dates; MaStR gives registration and planned COD dates only.
attributes.gap_note: MaStR exposes EinheitRegistrierungsdatum and GeplantesInbetriebnahmedatum in JSON, while permit decision dates in EinheitenGenehmigung.xml are absent for 92.7% of planned ground-mounted units. Baugenehmigung dates are not published, and municipal Bauleitplanung notices across ~11,000 municipalities were only sampled.

sources.name: Marktstammdatenregister (MaStR) — Öffentliche Einheitenübersicht & Gesamtdatenexport
sources.format: JSON API, CSV export, and daily bulk XML (ZIP)
sources.summary: Official federal energy register exposing voluntarily registered 'In Planung' solar PV units via a filterable JSON API, CSV export and a daily 3.31 GB XML archive (Gesamtdatenexport).
sources.coverage_note: 63,257 individual solar PV units in status 'In Planung' on 2026-11-25: 1,094 Freiflächensolaranlagen (across 1,053 park names), 45,008 Gebäudesolaranlagen, 17,135 Balkonkraftwerke and 20 Sonstige; 4,718 units exceed 30 kW (with coordinates) and 850 exceed 1 MWp.
caveats: Voluntary pre-commissioning for standard solar PV (§ 5(4) MaStRV); omits un-registered permitting pipelines.
Single 'In Planung' status does not separate zoning, building permit or active construction; multi-unit parks split across rows.
Coordinates/parcels withheld at <=30 kW and natural-person operators masked (§ 15(1) MaStRV).

sources.name: Zentrale Landesportale der Bauleitplanung (16 Bundesländer & DiPlanung-Portal)
sources.publisher: Bundesländer (State planning/interior ministries and GDI portals, partly federated via DiPlanung)
sources.format: Web map/search portals linking to municipal HTML pages, PDF plan documents and partial XPlanung WMS/WFS layers
sources.license: Varies by Land/municipality (mostly public inspection only; open geodata subsets under dl-de/by-2-0 or dl-de/zero-2-0)
sources.summary: Statutory state urban land-use planning portals (§§ 3(2), 10a BauGB) across all 16 Bundesländer (partly federated at portal.diplanung.de), providing access to municipal Bebauungspläne for ground-mounted solar parks.
sources.coverage_note: 16 of 16 state portals checked on 2026-11-25; records are general municipal planning procedures (no solar-only structured count) linking to ~11,000 municipalities' draft and adopted PDF plan packages.
caveats: Web viewers and municipal link directories only; no downloadable structured list of solar PV projects or MW capacities.
Covers non-privileged ground-mounted PV requiring a Bebauungsplan; excludes § 35(1) Nr. 8b BauGB corridor permits and rooftop PV.
Tracks zoning up to Satzungsbeschluss, not subsequent county Baugenehmigung or construction start.

problems: No unified national/state structured download of solar PV permitting records; portals serve interactive SPA maps or municipal link directories.

members_summary.scope_note: All 16 German Bundesländer central Bauleitplanung / GDI portals were opened and verified on 2026-11-25; none publishes a standalone structured solar-PV-in-permitting table (all expose map viewers, XPlanung/WMS plan boundaries or links to municipal procedure pages).
members_summary.pattern: Search '<Bundesland> zentrales Internetportal Bauleitplanung' or query https://portal.diplanung.de/, then follow municipal links to 'Bauleitpläne im Verfahren' / 'Öffentliche Auslegung' for 'Sondergebiet Photovoltaik'.

if_unstructured.summary: Because MaStR 'In Planung' is voluntary and merges all pre-commissioning phases while BNetzA lists only EEG tender winners, exact permitting stages (Aufstellungsbeschluss, § 3(2) Auslegung, § 10 Satzungsbeschluss), council decision dates, Vorhabenträger and grid-reservation MWp for non-privileged ground-mounted solar parks must be extracted from municipal Bebauungsplan PDFs via the 16 Länder Bauleitplanung portals and municipal websites.

local_terms.meaning: Ground-mounted solar PV installation (MaStR Art der Solaranlage code 852).
MaStR pre-commissioning unit status (code 31), covering voluntary entries from early planning through active construction.
Project-specific municipal binding land-use plan (§ 12 BauGB, § 11 BauNVO) creating zoning right for non-privileged solar parks.
Sequential municipal Bauleitplanung milestones: initiation (§ 2(1) BauGB), draft public consultation (§ 3(2) BauGB) and statutory adoption (§ 10 BauGB).
State-law construction permit issued by the county/city Bauaufsichtsbehörde (required after Satzungsbeschluss or directly for privileged § 35 BauGB corridor PV).

local_terms.term: Ausschreibungen für Solaranlagen des ersten / zweiten Segments
local_terms.meaning: BNetzA EEG competitive tenders for ground-mounted/non-building PV (1st segment) and rooftop/noise-barrier PV >1 MW (2nd segment).
DC module peak capacity under STC versus AC nominal capacity limited by generator/inverter in MaStR.
Project developer/applicant named in urban land-use plans and UVP screenings.
